tldr: Moon in the 7th house: emotional needs and comfort center on partnership and one-to-one bonds
body: Moon in the 7th house: emotional needs and comfort center on partnership and one-to-one bonds. Gift: deep feeling there. Watch: moods ride on it. With the Moon in the 7th house, emotional needs, instinct, memory, care, and the search for safety move through partnership, marriage, clients, contracts, and open conflict. This makes how you meet others, let yourself be met, and handle equality in relationship a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs. Left unconscious, it can become mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area.
gift: emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs expressed through one-to-one bonds.
challenge: mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area concentrated in one-to-one bonds.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
